overall_notes: This paper focuses on privacy-preserving language model training rather than NLG quality evaluation. The main NLG task is dialogue generation, evaluated primarily using perplexity. The paper introduces a new method (CRT) for training language models with confidentiality guarantees and evaluates privacy risks through canary insertion and membership inference attacks rather than traditional NLG quality metrics.
